''For a summary of all translated versions of The Wheel of Time see [[The Wheel of Time translations]].''

'''The Wheel of Time''' in Ukrainian is '''Колесо часу'''. The books are currently being translated for the first time by Bohdan. Seven  books have been published as of April 2025. Given the rate of publication, more books will follow in the coming years.

==Book Titles==
Only books 1-7 translated so far. The rest of the book names are taken from [https://uk.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9A%D0%BE%D0%BB%D0%B5%D1%81%D0%BE_%D1%87%D0%B0%D1%81%D1%83 Ukrainian wikipedia].

Prequel: '''New Spring''' - Нова весна
